pattern: IV-06 provider withdraws the over-quote invoice and reissues at the approved quote after being queried
notes: Family 007-ioq, variant v11. Base event 031 kept (invoice 2311, £277.72 plus VAT). Appended events 032-036; 032-035 are the same as in v09 (on 08/10 the agency notes the invoice is not passed for payment, asks Clarke to explain and itemise, tells the landlord nothing will be paid until he agrees, hold 'Waiting for Provider'). 036 (Thu 09/10 08:40): Clarke apologises, says the £277.72 included the call-out and materials from another job by mistake, asks the agency to void 2311, and gives revised invoice no. 2311A (replaces 2311) for two spotlights and one ceiling board at £198.37 plus VAT (£238.04 inc VAT), 14 days, with two named photos (not in attachments/). Total events 36, marker at 037. Attachment-02-tax-invoice.pdf removed as in the base. Expected: record 2311A at £238.04 (matches the approval at event 011), treat 2311 as void so it cannot also be paid, send 2311A to the landlord for payment saying the difference is resolved at the approved amount, final checks, close. No landlord re-approval and no escalation are needed.
